definition: PHYLIP-to-FASTA adapter time (including decompression for compressed inputs) plus synchronized native FASTA-file-to-tree time after CUDA EAGER initialization and TBB warmup
hardware: same Linux host, NVIDIA L40S GPU0 gene / GPU1 species, 16 NUMA-local logical CPUs per worker, no shared-GPU process concurrency
execution_model: CUDA/TBB-preinitialized fresh CLI process per input, not a retained DIPPER session
accuracy: Historical accuracy retained with its original source/tree/hash. Rerun accuracy is an independent downloadable check.
limitations: GPU-preinitialized fresh CLI process per record; not a retained DIPPER session benchmark
historical and new wall-time differences also reflect concurrency, affinity and host state, not a pure cold-start speedup
other comparator histories remain heterogeneous; no hardware-normalized universal speedup claim
